cues.zh: 在英国，对巴拿马文件泄露的反应有点奇怪。
cues.en: In Britain, the reaction to the Panama Papers leak has been a bit weird.

cues.zh: 政客们纷纷公布自己的纳税申报摘要，
cues.en: Politicians have been releasing summaries of their tax returns,

cues.zh: 争先恐后地试图证明自己没有离岸账户，
cues.en: all falling over each other to try and prove that they haven't got any offshore accounts

cues.zh: 或者激烈地争辩说，他们不应该被要求证明
cues.en: or arguing strongly that they shouldn't have to prove

cues.zh: 自己没有离岸账户。
cues.en: that they don't have any offshore accounts.

cues.zh: 其中一位说，要求政客公开纳税申报
cues.en: One of them said that requiring politicians to have public tax returns

cues.zh: “让人想起斯塔西或克格勃”。
cues.en: was "reminiscent of the Stasi or the KGB".

cues.zh: 欢迎来到挪威。我身后是奥斯陆税务局。
cues.en: Welcome to Norway. Behind me is the Oslo tax office.

cues.zh: 如果你想知道这里的政客赚多少钱，直接问他们就行。
cues.en: And if you want to know what a politician earns here, you can just ask them.

cues.zh: 不过，不只是政客。
cues.en: It's not just politicians, though.

cues.zh: 是所有人。在挪威、瑞典和芬兰，纳税申报已经公开多年：
cues.en: It's everyone. Tax returns in Norway, Sweden and Finland have been public for years:

cues.zh: 各国在披露的详细程度上有所不同，
cues.en: the countries differ on how much detail they provide,

cues.zh: 以及你是否需要有正当理由才能查询——
cues.en: and whether you need to have a good reason for asking --

cues.zh: 但基本上，你赚多少钱在这里是公开信息。
cues.en: but fundamentally the amount you earn is public knowledge here.

cues.zh: 说到这里，我们可以做新闻报道那套，
cues.en: Now, at this point, we could do the news report thing,

cues.zh: 切到街头采访挪威人，
cues.en: and cut to interviews with Norwegian people on the street,

cues.zh: 问问他们对此怎么看。
cues.en: asking how they feel about this.

cues.zh: 或者：我们可以用科学方法来研究，
cues.en: Or: we could science it,

cues.zh: 看看微软研究院经济学家 Ricardo Perez-Truglia 的一篇论文。
cues.en: and look at a paper by economist Ricardo Perez-Truglia of Microsoft Research.

cues.zh: 那篇论文结合了两样东西：第一，挪威监测调查，
cues.en: That paper combines two things: first, the Norwegian Monitor Survey,

cues.zh: 该调查每两年对具有代表性的挪威人样本进行调查，
cues.en: which, every two years, surveys a representative sample of Norwegians

cues.zh: 其中包含关于幸福感和生活满意度的问题。
cues.en: and includes questions about happiness and life satisfaction.

cues.zh: 第二，当查询别人的税务信息从
cues.en: And second, when finding out someone else's tax details went from

cues.zh: “你得亲自去那里翻一本册子，
cues.en: "you have to go here and look through a book,

cues.zh: 而且一年只有三周时间能查”
cues.en: "and you've only got three weeks in the year to do it"

cues.zh: 变成了“有报纸把所有信息都发布到网上，还有个搜索框”。
cues.en: to "a newspaper has published everything online and there's a search box".

cues.zh: 论文的结论是，工资透明化，
cues.en: The paper concludes that wage transparency,

cues.zh: 也就是知道你是否跟得上邻居，
cues.en: that knowing whether you're keeping up with the Joneses,

cues.zh: 或者说跟得上 Johansen 一家，
cues.en: or the Johansens,

cues.zh: 并不会让整体民众更幸福。
cues.en: doesn't make the populace happier overall.

cues.zh: 相反，它扩大了幸福感差距：
cues.en: Instead, it increases the happiness gap:

cues.zh: 确切知道自己比邻居挣得多
cues.en: knowing for certain you're being paid more than your neighbours

cues.zh: 会让你对生活更满意。
cues.en: makes you more likely to be satisfied with your life.

cues.zh: 确切知道自己不如别人？那很伤人。
cues.en: Knowing for certain that you're not doing as well? That hurts.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，在挪威你仍然可以在网上查别人的纳税申报表。
cues.en: You can still look up people's tax returns online in Norway, by the way.

cues.zh: 但最近，你必须自己以纳税人身份登录，
cues.en: But lately, you have to log in as a taxpayer yourself,

cues.zh: 而且所有人都能看到谁搜索过自己的记录。
cues.en: and everyone can see the records of who's been searching for them.

cues.zh: 这又是完全不同的社交博弈了。
cues.en: That's a whole different social game right there.

cues.zh: 但工资透明还有另一个有力论据：
cues.en: But there is another good argument for wage transparency:

cues.zh: 它能让世界更公平。
cues.en: that it makes for a fairer world.

cues.zh: 目前还没有强有力的数据支持这一点，至少我没找到，
cues.en: There's no strong data on that yet, not that I can find,

cues.zh: 而且这极难衡量。
cues.en: and it'd be extremely difficult to measure.

cues.zh: 但有一些不错的轶事证据，
cues.en: But there's some good anecdotal evidence,

cues.zh: 尤其来自Google的一位工程师，他创建了一个电子表格
cues.en: particularly from an engineer at Google who created a spreadsheet

cues.zh: 让同事们可以自愿分享自己的薪资。
cues.en: where their colleagues could voluntarily share their salaries.

cues.zh: 围绕它的来龙去脉，以及管理层对此的反应，都很值得一读。
cues.en: The story around it, and how management reacted to that, is well worth a read.

cues.zh: 而且也有证据表明，
cues.en: And there's also evidence that,

cues.zh: 尽管政客们可能不喜欢，
cues.en: although politicians might not like it,

cues.zh: 公开纳税申报表确实能减少逃税。
cues.en: public disclosure of tax returns does reduce tax evasion.

cues.zh: 那么这是否意味着我要公开自己的纳税申报表，
cues.en: So does this mean I'm about to share my tax return,

cues.zh: 向全世界报告我去年赚了多少钱？
cues.en: and report to the world how much I made last year?

cues.zh: 不。因为我是英国人，
cues.en: No. Because I'm British,

cues.zh: 因为我们不谈论钱，
cues.en: because we don't talk about money,

cues.zh: 你可能会发现一些你不想知道的事……
cues.en: you might find out something you don't want to know...

cues.zh: 或者你可能会伤害到别人。
cues.en: or you might hurt someone else.

cues.zh: 所以我对薪资透明的反应和很多人一样：
cues.en: So my reaction to wage transparency is the same as a lot of people's:

cues.zh: 你先来。
cues.en: you first.
